findings.description: The rewrite drops the removal of param.secondary_opts from the help option names, so names reserved only as a secondary option no longer get excluded.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command has a flag declared as a secondary option matching the help name, such as click.option('--x/--help'), so '--help' appears in that param's secondary_opts and not in its opts. The old code removed '--help' from the candidates via difference_update(param.secondary_opts). The new loop only iterates param.opts, so '--help' stays a help option and collides with the user's parameter, which can cause a parser conflict or the help option shadowing the user's flag. The impact is that the user's secondary flag stops working or the help option is wrongly registered.
